notes: Shower block without the boundary box: only the shower symbol.
Shower block redrawn as a shower head with a pipe and falling water, easy to read in the plan.
New blocks: Dressing table, Sliding wardrobe, Split AC and TV panel, plus a clearer Shower (round rain shower head and floor drain).
Offset: From a wall make › A line, to draw a line at the offset distance from a wall face (or centre) instead of a new wall.
PDF and Zoom fit: texts no longer add hidden empty space around the drawing, so the plan prints much bigger and fills the page.
Export PDF: Page margin Narrow (5 mm, default), Very narrow (3 mm) or Normal (10 mm), and a slimmer title box, so the drawing gets more of the page.
